name: Yamaha YDS-3 / Big Bear
engine: 246 cc air-cooled two-stroke twin, two carbs, Autolube on later models
intro: Yamaha's 60s 250 twins, including the Big Bear scrambler. Rare now, with parts to hunt down.

B: Early ones run premix, later ones have Autolube. Check which yours has before you fill the tank.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
